subject: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update

Team —

We need to lock the QBR/investor update deck timeline and consolidate OKR callouts by end of day Thursday so we can circulate the board packet Friday morning PST. High-level plan below: 

- Today (Wed): owners submit final slide text + data points to the shared drive. Use the OKR tracker to mark status (On track / At risk / Missed) and add 1-2 sentence impact statements.
- Thu 12:00pm PT: all editorial edits due (wording, metric pulls).
- Thu 5:00pm PT: design/slide refresh pass complete.
- Fri 8:00am PT: pkg sent to Board mailing list.

Asks: 
1) Evelyn — please collapse engineering/regression OKR items into a single two-slide narrative and call out remediation timeline for the three at-risk initiatives.
2) Marcus — can you validate the ARR bridge and gross margin bridges? I linked the finance workbook.
3) Tessa — run a quick redline sweep on the investor language; we want concise risk language and a one-paragraph exec summary.

Attached: QBR_slide_pack_v4_draft.pptx (working), OKR_tracker_2028_Q4.xlsx. Master folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQBR-BoardPacket

If you can't hit an ask, flag with a short note and I'll reassign. Small ask: please avoid introducing new metrics at this stage — add under 'Appendix' if needed.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Finance & Strategy | Redwood Inference
(attachment: QBR_slide_pack_v4_draft.pptx)
(attachment: OKR_tracker_2028_Q4.xlsx)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update

On Wed, Nov 8, 2028 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We need to lock the QBR/investor update deck timeline and consolidate OKR callouts by end of day Thursday...

Jordan — thanks, noted. I'm combining the engineering OKRs into the "Platform Reliability & Optimization" two-slide section. Key edits: 

- Slide 12 (Platform health): condensed to one chart + one bullet list of top three incidents and mitigations (ETA to close).
- Slide 13 (Performance optimizations): split into "cost wins" and "latency wins" with before/after numbers.

Open items for you/Marcus: we need the final token-throughput metric for Aug–Oct to compute the cost-per-1k-tokens improvement. Marcus — if you can confirm the numbers in the attached ops snapshot, I will lock the wording.

Attached: ops_metrics_snapshot_nov08.pdf (includes monthly throughput and cache-hit rates).

Evelyn Hart
VP, Engineering Operations | Redwood Inference
(attachment: ops_metrics_snapshot_nov08.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update

Jordan / Evelyn —

Quick confirmation: finance updated the ARR bridge numbers this morning after last week's bookings. I pushed a new tab in the finance workbook and added three small callouts for one-off adjustments (partner credits, deferred revenue recognition).

I'll lock the ARR and margin slides by 3:00pm PT. Evelyn — I used the throughput numbers you shared to update the cost-per-1k token slide; see the green cells.

Also, assigning slide ownership to make the editorial pass cleaner: 
- Exec summary: Jordan
- GTM KR/Bookings: Marcus
- Platform & Ops: Evelyn
- Risks & Remediation: Tessa

If anyone wants to swap ownership, flag now.

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Park <sparkinvest@stonebridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: board@avacapital.com
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update

Jordan —

Thanks for the timeline. A couple high-level asks from the Board side before the freeze: 

1) Please include a one-slide ARR bridge with quarterly movements and a short note on the three largest drivers (new logo, expansion, churn).
2) Add a one-paragraph margin note that explains the primary levers for improvement and any timing assumptions.
3) We prefer no substantive content additions after the Friday packet send; small wording edits are fine.

We appreciate the mobility on timing. If you can hit the Friday distribution, we'll schedule a 30-minute readout with the Board on Monday morning PT.

Samantha Park
Partner, Stonebridge Ventures
(sgcc: board@avacapital.com)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update

On Thu, Nov 9, 2028 at 08:15 AM Samantha Park <sparkinvest@stonebridge.com> wrote:
> Jordan —
> 
> Thanks for the timeline. A couple high-level asks from the Board side before the freeze...

All — updated plan and next actions below. I pulled together a small editorial playbook in the Drive (linked) to standardize language and bold metrics for the exec summary. I also pushed a draft "ARR bridge" slide into the package (tab: finance/arr_bridge).

Freeze plan (final):
- Thu 12:00pm PT: editorial pass completes (I will accept inline comments only after this window).
- Thu 5:00pm PT: design pass complete; anything left will be appendix.
- Fri 8:00am PT: Board packet distributed.

I've attached the current working deck as QBR_slide_pack_v4_draft.pptx — please treat as live. If you are the slide owner, accept or resolve comments by 12pm.

DocuSign / approvals: we'll use the Board packet signature process for the final cover letter — I will circulate the DocuSign once the package is finalized.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Corporate Communications | Redwood Inference
(attachment: QBR_slide_pack_v4_draft.pptx)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samantha Park <sparkinvest@stonebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Nov 2028 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QBR deck freeze schedule + OKR synthesis for investor update

Thanks all — great work and fast turnaround.

Status update: 
- Marcus: ARR/margin slides locked at 15:00 PT.
- Evelyn: platform slides locked at 14:30 PT.
- Tessa: editorial sweep complete; branding/design pass done.

I am locking the package as of 15:30 PT today. That means: no new substantive content; only wording/typo fixes via comments. Final deck (QBR_slide_pack_v4_final.pptx) will be the version we send Friday morning. Tessa — please initiate DocuSign for the cover letter after the 5pm design pass.

Next steps: Friday 08:00am PT distribution to Board mailing list (board@avacapital.com) and investor relations. Monday 09:00am PT readout with Board (link to calendar invite to follow).

Thanks —
Jordan
Head of Finance & Strategy | Redwood Inference
(attachment: QBR_slide_pack_v4_final.pptx)
